title: Escape from Hastinapur
logline: On a tense night before the great war, a young courier on foot must carry a villagers' plea for grain relief through Hastinapur's lantern-lit streets and out the east gate before dawn.

objectives.text: Reach the Lamp Bazaar and take on Suvrata and the sealed plea.
Cross the canal bridge before the watch bells close it.
Reach the East Gate before the first light of dawn.

dialogue.speaker: Bhadra
dialogue.text: The city is on edge. Keep your lamp low and your steps quiet, Tarak.

dialogue.speaker: Tarak
dialogue.text: Three stops, then the east road. I know the way.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: Here. The plea from the farm villages. Hold the tablet flat and run.

dialogue.speaker: Tarak
dialogue.text: Hold tight. The canal bridge is next.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: The bells are ringing. Once the bridge lifts, we are stuck.

dialogue.speaker: Tarak
dialogue.text: Across. Now the east gate, and the dawn is coming.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Dandaka
dialogue.text: Open the gate. I read your tablet. Those fields feed my kin too.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: That was a lantern cone. Stay in the shadows!

dialogue.speaker: Tarak
dialogue.text: Your hands are shaking. Steady, steady.

dialogue.speaker: Bhadra
dialogue.text: They caught you. Come back to the stable and try another lane.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: We can still go. The watch changes at the bells. Wait for them.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: The plea will reach the village elders by morning. Thank you, Tarak.

dialogue.speaker: Tarak
dialogue.text: No glory in this. Just a road that stayed open.
